senses.gloss: הִרְהִין (a contract, of רהבן, cmp. רַהֲבוֹנָא a. Lat. arrha; v. עֵרָבוֹן) to deposit as a pledge, contrad. to מִשְׁכֵּן to take a pledge.
units: <cite ref="Tosefta Ma'aser Sheni 1:1">Tosef. Maas. Sh. I, 1</cite> <he>מעשר שני … ואין מַרְהִינִין אותו</he> ed. Zuck. (Var. <he>מְהַרְהִינִין</he>) second tithes must neither be sold, nor taken or given as a pledge; Y. ib. I, 52ᶜ top. Ib. <he>עבר והי׳ וכ׳</he> if he pledged it in defiance of the law, he is fined.
<cite ref="Pesachim 31a:9">Pes. 31ᵃ</cite> <he>כשהִרְהִינוֹ אצלו</he> when he deposited it (the leavened matter) with him (the gentile) as a pledge.
